items.where: Queen Wilhelmina seated side-saddle in a long riding habit and a brimmed hat, holding the reins low, bronze, about 1.7 m
items.how: builder: habit skirt as an open cone over the horse's left flank, torso cylinder, shoulders, head ball, hat brim and crown, two arms to the hands; no face or cuffs

items.where: bronze horse in a walking dressage step: arched neck, head tucked, near foreleg raised and folded, plumed tail
items.how: builder: ellipsoid barrel, croup and chest, tapered neck and head, four tapered legs (near fore raised, off hind a step back), tail limb, ears, saddle pad, bridle straps and reins; no musculature or mane texture

items.where: tall bronze pedestal shaped as an inverted pyramid (3.6 m long at the top, 1.2 m at the foot) over a stone pier on the bridge parapet
items.how: builder: lofted four-sided frustum with a slab top, stone pier and moulded cap below

items.where: WILHELMINA and 1880-1962 incised on the upper left face of the funnel
items.how: builder: 5x7 block letters as gilt run boxes on the leaning face (pixel-font.ts); the real lettering is incised thin capitals

walls.note: Horse's right side with the rider's back and the funnel's plain face (panorama Track05 00003).
Tail end: plain funnel face; same bronze funnel and pier.
Head end: the horse's chest and the raised near foreleg with the rider seen from the front-left.
